runners.name: Empress New Groove
runners.comment: EMPRESS NEW GROOVE tracked the leader on the inside up the backstretch, swung out to the four path to challenge passing the quarter pole and drew off in the lane.

runners.name: My Honey Mother
runners.comment: MY HONEY MOTHER led the way up the backstretch, came around the turn in the two path, was caught in upper stretch and chased on to the finish from there.

runners.name: Authentic Guitar
runners.comment: AUTHENTIC GUITAR brushed with the horse to his inside and was pinched back leaving the gate, raced off the pace on the rail early, came around the bend in the two path and improved position in the stretch.

runners.name: Noffies Late Nite
runners.comment: NOFFIES LATE NITE raced in the middle of the pack on the outside through the opening stages, navigated the turn from the four path and finished evenly.

runners.name: Marz Eatoats
runners.comment: MARZ EATOATS brushed with the horse to his outside at the start, chased the leader from the rail up the backstretch, came around the turn in the three path and tired in the lane.

runners.name: Starship Spectacle
runners.comment: STARSHIP SPECTACLE raced off the pace on the outside up the backstretch, came around the bend in the three path and made no bid.

runners.name: Higher Self
runners.comment: HIGHER SELF raced in the middle of the pack on the inside through the opening quarter, dropped back while saving ground around the turn and was empty in the lane.

runners.name: Wearebackyoungman
runners.comment: WEAREBACKYOUNGMAN bumped with the horse to his outside at the start, tracked the leader from the rail up the backstretch, saved ground around the turn, dueled in the lane and kicked clear.

runners.name: Ruleroftheuniverse
runners.comment: RULEROFTHEUNIVERSE raced off the pace up the backstretch, began a bid from the four path coming around the bend, dueled in upper stretch and gave way in the final sixteenth, chasing the winner home from there.

runners.name: Nice Try Riley
runners.comment: NICE TRY RILEY raced in the middle of the pack between horses up the backstretch, navigated the turn from the two path and improved position in the lane.

runners.name: Commendatore
runners.comment: COMMENDATORE led the way on the outside through the opening quarter, came around the turn in the two path and faded in the stretch.

runners.name: Pardo
runners.comment: PARDO bumped with the horse to his inside leaving the gates, raced in the middle of the pack on the inside early, dropped back headed into the turn, raced in the three path from there and made no bid.

runners.name: Step Slow
runners.comment: STEP SLOW veered out at the break, chased the leader on the outside up the backstretch, came around the turn in the four path and tired in the stretch.

runners.name: Kazooza
runners.comment: KAZOOZA raced in the middle of the pack on the outside through the early going, continued around the bend in the four path and was empty in the lane.

runners.name: Guns of Roses
runners.comment: GUNS OF ROSES bumped with the horse to his inside leaving the gate, recovered to lead the way up the backstretch, continued around the bend in the two path and held clear to the wire while drifting in.

runners.name: Song of Sarah
runners.comment: SONG OF SARAH brushed with the horse to her outside at the start, had extended contact with that rival in the early going, chased the leader up what remained of the backstretch, saved ground around the bend, switched to the outside to find racing room in the lane and gained ground late from there.

runners.name: Treasured Times
runners.comment: TREASURED TIMES raced off the pace between horses through the opening stages, navigated the turn from the three path, began a bid passing the quarter pole and gained ground in the lane.

runners.name: Bon Vivant
runners.comment: BON VIVANT raced off the pace on the outside early, continued around the turn in the three path and was never a threat.

runners.name: Prime Time Lady
runners.comment: PRIME TIME LADY brushed with the horse to her outside leaving the gate, repeatedly bumped with that rival on the opening strides, settled into the middle of the pack from there, navigated the bend from the two path and was outkicked in the stretch.

runners.name: Always Praising
runners.comment: ALWAYS PRAISING raced off the pace on the inside up the backstretch, came around the turn in the two path and made no bid.

runners.name: Kiona
runners.comment: KIONA bumped with the horse to her inside at the break, trailed the field throughout, continued around the turn in the three path and was never a factor.

runners.name: Hidden Recipe
runners.comment: HIDDEN RECIPE raced in the middle of the pack between horses up the backstretch, continued around the turn in the four path, began a bid passing the quarter pole, dueled in upper stretch and kicked clear.

runners.name: Golden Valley
runners.comment: GOLDEN VALLEY chased the leader between horses up the backstretch, challenged from the three path coming around the bend, dueled in upper stretch and could not go with the winner late but kept on after that rival to the finish.

runners.name: Girvin Star
runners.comment: GIRVIN STAR led the way on the inside early, battled from the two path around the turn and in upper stretch, and gave way in the final furlong.

runners.name: Pretty Geisha
runners.comment: PRETTY GEISHA raced off the pace on the inside through the opening quarter, navigated the bend from the two path and showed no kick.

runners.name: Tape Runner
runners.comment: TAPE RUNNER trailed the field up the backstretch, continued around the bend in the three path and was never a threat.

runners.name: Miss Silipo
runners.comment: MISS SILIPO raced off the pace on the outside through the opening quarter, came around the turn in the three path and was empty in the stretch.

runners.name: Sweet Agenda
runners.comment: SWEET AGENDA stalked the leader on the outside up the backstretch, navigated the turn from the three path and faded in the lane.

runners.name: Honorable Seve
runners.comment: HONORABLE SEVE chased the leader up the backstretch, challenged from the three path coming around the turn and dug in gamely in the stretch, dueling to the finish to hold the win.

runners.name: Colonel Russell
runners.comment: COLONEL RUSSELL raced off the pace through the opening quarter, navigated the bend from the four path, began a bid entering the stretch and dueled to the wire to just miss.

runners.name: Fireballer
runners.comment: FIREBALLER dueled on the inside up the backstretch, saved ground around the turn, dug in in upper stretch and gave way in the final furlong.

runners.name: Tokenize
runners.comment: TOKENIZE hit the leaving it, dropped back to trail well behind the field racing up the backstretch, saved ground around the bend and made no bid.

runners.name: Mischief Holiday
runners.comment: MISCHIEF HOLIDAY dueled on the outside through the opening stages, continued to battle from the two path around the turn and tired in the stretch.

runners.name: Antillean
runners.comment: ANTILLEAN raced off the pace on the outside the backstretch, began a bid from the three path coming around the turn and kicked clear in the lane.

runners.name: Zozan
runners.comment: ZOZAN chased the leader through the opening quarter, continued around the turn in the two path and gained ground late.

runners.name: Khopesh
runners.comment: KHOPESH bumped with the horse to his inside leaving the gate, settled off the pace between horses up the backstretch, navigated the bend from the two path and gained ground late.

runners.name: Simo
runners.comment: SIMO dueled on the outside through the opening stages, saved ground around the bend and weakened in the lane.

runners.name: Bala de Plata
runners.comment: BALA DE PLATA bumped with the horse to her outside at the break, recovered to duel from the rail up the backstretch, saved ground around the bend and tired in the stretch.

runners.name: Swashbuckle
runners.comment: SWASHBUCKLE raced off the pace on the inside up the backstretch, trailed the field while saving ground around the turn and was empty in the stretch.

runners.name: Fede
runners.comment: FEDE bobbled leaving the gate, recovered to chase the leader up the backstretch, came around the turn in the two path and dueled to the wire to just get up for the win.

runners.name: Mad for Maddy
runners.comment: MAD FOR MADDY raced in the middle of the pack on the outside early, began a bid from the three path coming around the turn and dueled to the finish to get up for the win.

runners.name: Competitive Market
runners.comment: COMPETITIVE MARKET raced off the pace up the backstretch, swung out to the four path coming around the turn and improved position in the lane.

runners.name: Charlie's Wish
runners.comment: CHARLIE'S WISH raced in the middle of the pack on the inside up the backstretch, navigated the turn from the three path and was outkicked in the stretch.

runners.name: Social Fortress
runners.comment: SOCIAL FORTRESS led the way through the opening quarter, dueled while saving ground around the bend and tired in the lane.

runners.name: Slew Vinbiz
runners.comment: SLEW VINBIZ bumped with the horses to either side at the start, raced in the three path around the first turn, settled off the pace between horses for the run up the backstretch, came around the far turn still in the three path, bumped with URIELS DEGREE entering the stretch and kicked clear from there.

runners.name: Uriel's Decree
runners.comment: URIEL'S DECREE was pinched back leaving the gate, saved ground around the first bend, continued up the backstretch in the middle of the pack on the inside, navigated the far bend from the three path, raced into traffic coming into the lane and bumped with SLEW VINBIZ, and gained ground late.

runners.name: Megaplumb
runners.comment: MEGAPLUMB brushed with the horse to his outside at the start, raced in the two path early, chased the leader up the backstretch, navigated the far turn still in the two path and gave way late.

runners.name: Ready to Rage
runners.comment: READY TO RAGE bumped with the horse to his inside at the break, raced in the four path around the first turn, continued up the backstretch in the middle of the pack on the outside, continued around the far turn in the four path and made no bid.

runners.name: Mr. Hetty
runners.comment: MR. HETTY led the way while saving ground through the opening half mile, continued to save ground around the far turn and tired in the lane. A STEWARDS INQUIRY WAS MADE INTO THE QUARTER POLE. UPON REVIEW, NO CHANGES WERE MADE TO THE ORDER OF FINISH.

runners.name: Lightning Tones
runners.comment: LIGHTNING TONES brushed with the horse to his inside at the start, saved ground in the middle of the pack around the first turn and up the backstretch, came around the far turn in the three path, began a bid entering the stretch, and kicked clear.

runners.name: Bartholdy
runners.comment: BARTHOLDY brushed with the horse to his outside leaving the gate, raced in the three path around the first turn, led the way up the backstretch, continued around the far bend in the two path and was caught in the final furlong.

runners.name: Indecisiveness
runners.comment: INDECISIVENESS raced in the two path early, chased the leader on the inside up the backstretch, swung out to the four path coming around the second turn and kept on in the lane.

runners.name: Moonstrocity
runners.comment: MOONSTROCITY bumped with multiple horses leaving the gate, raced off the pace in the two path around the first turn and up the backstretch, saved ground around the far turn and was never a threat.

runners.name: Awesome Train
runners.comment: AWESOME TRAIN bumped with the horses to both sides at the start, raced in the two path around the first turn, trailed the field up the backstretch, continued around the far bend still in the two path and showed no kick.

runners.name: Palpable
runners.comment: PALPABLE brushed with the horse to his inside at the break, raced in the two path early, tracked the leaders between horses up the backstretch, dropped back while fanning out to the four path nearing the quarter pole and faded further in the lane.

runners.name: Digital Ops
runners.comment: DIGITAL OPS bumped with the horse to his inside leaving the gate, raced in the four path around the first turn, stalked the leaders on the outside up the backstretch, dropped back while saving ground around the second bend and continued to tire from there.

runners.name: Lou the Body
runners.comment: LOU THE BODY led the way up the long backstretch, saved ground around the turn and drew off in the lane.

runners.name: The Best Distance
runners.comment: THE BEST DISTANCE chased the leader up the backstretch, navigated the bend from the three path and kept on in the stretch.

runners.name: Brooklyn Guy
runners.comment: BROOKLYN GUY raced off the pace through the opening quarter, swung out to the four path coming around the turn and improved position from there.

runners.name: Blue Slide Park
runners.comment: BLUE SLIDE PARK trailed well behind the field racing up the backstretch, continued around the bend in the four path and made up some ground in the lane while never truly threatening.

runners.name: Jimbo Bailey
runners.comment: JIMBO BAILEY raced in the middle of the pack on the outside early, dropped back while saving ground the bend and tired in the lane.

runners.name: O Captain
runners.comment: O CAPTAIN raced in the middle of the pack on the inside up the backstretch, saved ground around the bend and was empty in the stretch.
